# FAQ

```{=html}
<back-to-top></back-to-top>
<atlas-toc heading-levels="2"></atlas-toc>
<script src="/components/langSwitcher.js"></script>
```

<!-- Rendered at build time by scripts/build/cmsContent.lua from the CMS-edited
     JSON (see admin/config.yml). Both languages are baked in; styles/main.css
     shows the active one via <html lang>. -->

::: {.docs-faq data-src="data/docs/faq.json"}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// The one thing CSS can't switch: section heading text (kept a single node
// so the TOC reads clean text).
window.addEventListener("atlas:lang", (e) => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".docs-faq h2[data-fr]").forEach((h) => {
    h.textContent = h.dataset[e.detail] || h.dataset.en;
  });
});
</script>
```
